items.name: GYM_RECORDS
items.summary: An Android app to log training and food, and check whether routines and diet help reach the goals. Pending: I want to take it forward.

I take part in the migration of an internal application from .NET Framework 4.7 to .NET 10, and I lead its technical side. The modules move from MVC to a headless architecture, with an API and React, on a modular monolith. I set up the deployments and pipelines with GitLab CI, built the billing module and bring AI agents into the development workflow.

I modernised an accounting system in Angular, with .NET endpoints. I also wrote a Python server that collected BLE data from gym devices and relayed it over WebSockets, and a WPF desktop app that showed that activity in real time.
